title: RugFlag
tagline: A bilingual site for a handmade rug studio, with a catalog of finished pieces and the option to commission a custom design.
summary: A visual, image-led project built around the work itself. The site lets you browse finished rugs, get a feel for the studio, and see how a custom rug commission works.
coverImageAlt: RugFlag homepage showing a close-up photo of colorful handmade tufted rugs with cartoon and pop-culture designs
